profile.headline: Embedded Security Software Engineer at Apple
profile.summary:
20 years of experience in security Smart Card software development with FIPS and Common Criteria compliance
- Focused on Customer support and deployment project management
- Expert in security authentication protocol definition and implementation (Symmetric, Asymmetric, Diffie-Hellmann key exchange, PKI)
- Expert in RFID/NFC standards ISO-14443 and Mifare (r) Technology
- Expert in identity application implementation (eID), including Passport (ICAO / eGov) and Driving Licence (IDL / eDL) standards : ecosystem, knowledge and implementation of security protocols (BAC, SAC, EAC) 
- Project and Technical leader on FIDO U2F 1.2 and FIDO 2.0 CTAP
- Customer support in Javacard security implementation / Global Platform (Amd C Contactless Service, Amd H ELF Update/Applet Migration, Amd I SEMS)

Fluent with Global Platform, JavaCard, Contactless and PIV standards

positions.title: Embedded security software engineer
positions.description: Skills: Mifare · Mobile Payments · RFID Applications · Apple Pay

positions.title: Principal Security Engineer
positions.description:
- Lead definition of ePassport (ICAO)/e Driving Licence (eDL) product from file contents to security protocol implementation and documentation, define validation protocol and produce common criteria documentation
- Security architecture of digital signature application (SSCD) with file system definition/implementation and software counter measures recommendation
- Design, implement and  document FIDO U2F and CTAP applet on USB/NFC token form factor

positions.title: Principal Field Application Engineer / Customer Application Support
positions.description:
- Manage project alignment and track progress on questions/problems between customers and internal R&D (SFDC Sales Force)
- Product validation before delivery with in-house scripts development and quality consistency verification
- Support customer with eSIM / eUICC integration and validation
- Support customers with Secure Element (JCOP) integration in mobile / IOT environment
- Support customers in integrating and adopting NXP secure cloud solutions for Payment (mWallet2Go) and Transit (Mifare2Go). Promote Service2Go solution to customers (pre-sales) 
- Provide trainings on Service2Go products and JCOP Operating System  (JavaCard OS in Secure Element)

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Mobile Payments · RFID Applications

positions.title: Javacard application manager
positions.description: Javacard application manager responsible of designing, implementing and validating application based on JC 2.2.2 platform

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Integration of PUF(r) technology in Android OS
- Study implementation of PUF authentication mechanism in TEE (Trusted Execution Environment)

positions.title: Senior smartcard Development Engineer
positions.description:
Javacard application manager responsible of designing, implementing and validating application based on JC 2.2.2 platform

- Design, implementation, test and documentation of PKI Javacard application

- Development , validation and documentation for Common Criteria certification of ePassport application

- Development , validation and documentation for Common Criteria certification of European Citizen Card application

- Development , validation and documentation for FIPS certification of PIV  application

positions.title: OS Development engineer
positions.description: Global architecture analysis and development related to the NFC (Near Field Communication) product

positions.title: Research engineer
positions.description:
Responsible of the technology survey on facial biometrics using smartcard
Study on DRM management prototype inside a smartcard

positions.title: Development engineer
positions.description:
Development of the Javacard smartcard kernel (C and Javacard)
Secure integration of telecom authentication algorithm (GSM, UMTS)
Development of the main telecom layer applications (Network management and authentication, SIM, USIM)
